items.t: Rear frame rust can let the fuel tank drop (recall)
items.job: Rear frame inspection and repair under recall
items.note: Free under recall 22V-430. Honda may offer a buyback if the frame cannot be repaired.

items.t: Driver air bag inflator can rupture (Takata recall)
items.note: Free inflator replacement under the Takata recalls (15V-320, 16V-061, 19V-182, 19V-499, 19V-500).

items.t: Passenger air bag inflator can rupture (Takata recall)
items.note: Free inflator replacement under the Takata passenger recalls (16V-344, 17V-029, 18V-041, 18V-662, 19V-501 and earlier regional campaigns).

items.t: Radiator transmission cooler leaks and mixes coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission and cooling system
items.note: If coolant already damaged the transmission, a replacement transmission can push the bill past $4,000.

items.t: Overdue timing belt or leaking tensioner can wreck the engine
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idlers and water pump
items.note: If the belt already failed, engine repair can cost $3,000-$5,000 or more.

items.t: Cylinder 4 misfire and oil burning
items.job: Engine repair for worn piston ring (or used engine)
items.note: Owners report average costs around $2,900. A used engine can be cheaper than a rebuild.

items.t: Misfires on the rear cylinder bank
items.job: Replace spark plugs and one ignition coil
items.note: Rear-bank plugs take extra time to reach.

items.t: Oil leak from the VTEC spool valve onto the alternator
items.note: If the alternator was soaked, add about $300-$600 for a new one. A full spool valve assembly runs about $250-$350.

items.t: Power steering pump whines, mostly when cold
items.job: Replace power steering feed-pipe O-ring and flush fluid
items.note: If the pump is worn, a new pump costs roughly $300-$600 installed.

items.t: Front-end clunk from sway bar links or ball joints
items.note: Ball joint or lower control arm replacement costs about $350-$900.

items.t: Gauge cluster display fails
items.note: Owners report an average cost around $1,100 at a dealer.

items.t: A/C or heater stops working
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge
items.note: A failed relay costs under $30. Owners report average bills around $2,300 when major parts fail.

items.t: Blower motor connector can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free connector replacement and cover under recall 10V-001.

items.t: Fuel pump relay can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free relay replacement under recall 07V-097.

items.t: Hood can fall shut when propped open (recall)
items.note: Free reinforcement under recall 07V-542.

items.t: Fuel injector failure causes misfires
items.note: Owners report average costs around $2,200. Check whether Honda warranty coverage still applies.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free fuel pump module replacement under recalls 23V-858 and 21V-215.

items.t: Fuel pump cover can crack from car wash soap (recall)
items.note: Free inspection, pump replacement if needed and protective cover under recall 19V-053.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing can wear and seize (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and engine repair or replacement under recall 23V-751.

items.t: Timing belt teeth can separate (recall)
items.note: Free timing belt replacement and engine inspection under recall 19V-298.

items.t: Rear subframe can rust at the suspension mounts (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and reinforcement kit under recall 26V-365.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor fault can affect the air bag (recall)
items.note: Free sensor replacement under recalls 24V-064 and 26V-332.

items.t: Backup camera image goes blank (recall)
items.note: Free tailgate camera harness replacement under recalls 22V-867 and 24V-321.

items.t: Hood can fly open while driving (recall)
items.note: Free striker repair or hood replacement under recall 21V-932.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can separate from the booster (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and booster repair under recall 23V-458.

items.t: Steering gearbox ball joint can loosen (recall)
items.note: Free inspection and steering gearbox replacement under recall 24V-184.

items.t: Air bag control unit may not deploy air bags (recall)
items.note: Free control unit replacement under recall 18V-664.

items.t: Transmission warning light or transmission failure
items.note: Owners report averages from about $4,000 for repairs up to $10,500 for replacement.

items.t: Oil leak on a new truck
items.job: Diagnose and repair oil leak under warranty
items.note: Covered by the new-vehicle warranty.
